USER.CREATE: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS <>_user(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,name TEXT,password TEXT, username TEXT UNIQUE,mobile TEXT,emailid TEXT, role INTEGER, active INTEGER, image TEXT, created_by Integer, created_date TEXT, modify_by Integer, modify_date TEXT)
USER.SELECT_USER_NAME: SELECT name, active FROM <>_user WHERE username = ? COLLATE NOCASE
USER.SELECT_USER_NAME_PASS: SELECT id, name, username, role, password, active FROM <>_user WHERE username = ? COLLATE NOCASE
USER.INSERT: INSERT INTO <>_user (name, password, username, mobile, emailid, role, active, image, created_by, created_date) VALUES (?, ?,?, ?, ?,?,?,?,?, datetime('now'))
USER.SELECT_ALL: Select id,name, emailid, role,username, mobile, image, active from <>_user
USER.SELECT_USER: select id, name, username,role, emailid, mobile, active, image from <>_user where active = 1
USER.SELECT_USER_BY_ROLE: select id,name, username, role, emailid, mobile, image, active from <>_user where role = ? and active = 1
USER.SELECT_USER_BYID: select id,name, role, username, emailid, mobile, active, image from <>_user where id = ? and active = 1
USER.SELECT_USER_BYEMAILID: select id,name, role, username, emailid, mobile, active, image from <>_user where emailid = ? and active = 1 Limit 1
USER.SELECT_USER_NAME_PASSById: SELECT id, name, username, role, password,emailid, active FROM <>_user WHERE id = ?

LEAD.CREATE: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS <>_lead(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, name TEXT UNIQUE,company_name TEXT, city TEXT,state TEXT, contact_number TEXT, enquiry_type TEXT, email TEXT, requirement TEXT, stage TEXT, next_followup TEXT, status TEXT, assigned_to Integer, assigned_by Integer, active INTEGER, created_by Integer,created_date TEXT, modify_by Integer, modify_date TEXT)
LEAD.INSERT: INSERT INTO <>_lead(name ,company_name, city, state, contact_number, enquiry_type, email, requirement, active, status, created_by, created_date) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,1,'open',?, datetime('now'))
LEAD.SELECT_ALL: select a.*, COALESCE(b.name, 'Unassigned') AS assigned_user from <>_lead as a left join <>_user as b on a.assigned_to = b.id
LEAD.SELECT_BY_LEADID: select * from <>_lead where id = ? and active = 1
LEAD.COUNT: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS total FROM <>_lead GROUP BY status;
LEAD.COUNT_BY_USER: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS total FROM <>_lead where (assigned_to is NULL) OR assigned_to = ? GROUP BY status;

PROJECT.CREATE: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS <>_project(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, lead_id INTEGER, stage TEXT, next_followup TEXT, status TEXT, assigned_to Integer, assigned_by Integer, active INTEGER, created_by Integer,created_date TEXT, modify_by Integer, modify_date TEXT)
PROJECT.INSERT: INSERT INTO <>_project(lead_id, stage, status, active, created_by, created_date) VALUES (?, ?,?, ?, ?, datetime('now'))
PROJECT.SELECT_ALL: select a.*, COALESCE(b.name, 'Unassigned') AS assigned_user, c.*  from <>_project as a left join <>_user as b on a.assigned_to = b.id left join <>_lead as c on a.lead_id = c.id
PROJECT.SELECT_BY_PROJID: select * from <>_project where id = ? and active = 1
PROJECT.COUNT: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS total FROM <>_project GROUP BY status;
PROJECT.COUNT_BY_USER: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS total FROM <>_project where (assigned_to is NULL) OR assigned_to = ? GROUP BY status;

LEAD_TIMELINE.CREATE: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS <>_leadtimline(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, lead_id INTEGER, message TEXT, docs_urls TEXT, created_by Integer,created_date TEXT)
LEAD_TIMELINE.INSERT: INSERT INTO <>_leadtimline(lead_id, message, docs_urls, created_by, created_date) VALUES (?, ?,?, ?, datetime('now'))
LEAD_TIMELINE.SELECT: SELECT a.*, COALESCE(b.name, 'Unassigned') AS created_from FROM <>_leadtimline as a left join <>_user as b on a.created_by = b.id  where a.lead_id = ?

PROJECT_TIMELINE.CREATE: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS <>_projecttimline(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, project_id INTEGER, message TEXT, docs_urls TEXT, created_by Integer,created_date TEXT)
PROJECT_TIMELINE.INSERT: INSERT INTO <>_projecttimline(project_id, message, docs_urls, created_by, created_date) VALUES (?, ?,?, ?, datetime('now'))
PROJECT_TIMELINE.SELECT: SELECT a.*, COALESCE(b.name, 'Unassigned') AS created_from FROM <>_projecttimline as a left join <>_user as b on a.created_by = b.id where project_id = ?

ROLE.CREATE: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user_role(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,name TEXT UNIQUE)

COMPANY.CREATE: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS company(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,name TEXT UNIQUE, aliasname TEXT, active INTEGER, created_date TEXT)
COMPANY.INSERT: INSERT INTO company (name, aliasname, active, created_date) VALUES (?, ?, ?, datetime('now'))
COMPANY.SELECT_COMPANY_NAME: SELECT name FROM company WHERE name = ?
COMPANY.SELECT_COMPANY_ALIASNAME: SELECT name FROM company WHERE aliasname = ? COLLATE NOCASE
